sentences.text: 1. This hearing has been through hybrid mode.
CRL.M.A. 34872/2025 (delay)
2. This application seeks condonation of delay of 5 days in re-filing the appeal.
3. For the reasons stated in the application, the delay is condoned.
4. The application is disposed of.

5. The present appeal under 413 & 419 of the BNSS, 2023, has been filed by the Appellant, who is the mother of the minor victim in this case, challenging the impugned judgment dated 5th August, 2025 passed by the ld. ASJ (FTSC) (POCSO)-01, Central District, Delhi, in Sessions Case No.801/2017 arising out of FIR No.355/2017 registered for offences punishable under Sections 376 IPC & 6 of POCSO Act, at PS Sarai Rohilla.

sentences.text:
However, the prosecution has failed to prove its case against the accused beyond all reasonable doubts, Accordingly, accused Amit Kaushik s/o Late Sh. Satish Kumar Sharma is hereby acquitted of all the offences charged under Sections 376 IPC &
6 POCSO Act in present case."

6. Admit.
7. Issue Notice.
Mr. Bahri, ld. APP accepts notice on behalf of the State.

Let notice be also served upon Respondent No. 2/accused through the Concerned I.O.
8.
The Registry is directed to requisition the TCR and prepare the appeal paperbook with proper indexing, pagination and bookmarks expeditiously.
Let the TCR be tagged along with this appeal by the next date of hearing.
9. Let the ld.
Counsels for the Parties obtain the copy of the TCR, as also the paperbook, and make their submissions on the next date of hearing.

10. Let the physical TCR be requisitioned to the Court on the next date of hearing by the Registry.
11.
List on 15th April, 2026.
PRATHIBA M. SINGH, J MADHU JAIN, J FEBRUARY 2, 2026/prg/ss
